title: Medication Reference
description: Added searchable medication lookup using FDA drug labeling, with expandable indications, warnings, contraindications, adverse reactions, dosing information, and interactions.

title: Lab / Medical Reference
description: Added a searchable at-a-glance reference for common adult laboratory values, organized by CBC, BMP/CMP, liver, coagulation, ABG, cardiac, and critical-care categories.

title: Education Tabs
description: Updated Education with a Study the Current Protocol tab and a TLC tab that opens the HealthStream TLC login.

title: Transfer Protocol
description: Added a native-text Transfer Protocol reference under Useful Information, with a responsive layout for the 4 ALS, 5 ALS, and Basic schedules.

title: AHA Algorithms
description: Added AHA algorithm categories and selectable algorithm references, with links to the official AHA flowcharts and offline quick-reference content.

title: What's New Update Feed
description: What's New now supports online update feeds with local caching so previously retrieved updates remain available offline.

title: Oxygen Tank Calculator
description: Added oxygen tank duration calculations with C (Small) and G (Large) cylinder options.

title: EMS Calculators
description: Added IV drip rate, GCS, and burn calculators to the Tools section.

title: ASL / Deaf Patient Tool
description: Added speech-to-text display for showing spoken English in large, readable text during patient communication.

title: Translator
description: Added English-to-Spanish translation with speech input and Spanish text-to-speech playback.

title: Dark Mode
description: Added persistent light/dark theme selection in Settings.
